ACKS-CLASSES.modifiers.failed: That change could not be written to the class training effect.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.name: Class name
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.stubNotice: This class has no progression rows yet. Fill the Progression tab by hand, or import the class from your book with a macro in ACKS Extras Macros → Import from your books.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.xpUnread: Some levels have no experience figure: the import could not read it from your book. Type each level's experience and title on the Progression tab from your copy ({cite}).
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.titlesUnread: The levels have no titles: the import could not read them from your book. Type each level's title on the Progression tab from your copy ({cite}).
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.xpBuildTip: Priced by the class-creation procedure (JJ ch. 12) from the class's build: Hit Dice {hd}, Fighting {fighting}, Thievery {thievery}, magic {magic}, racial value {race} at {raceCost} XP from the book's race page, {tradeoffs} trade-offs. 2nd level: {base} XP.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.casting.none: No casting traditions — add one to make this class a caster.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.casting.casterLevelHi: A ladder key whose rung at the character's level is this tradition's caster level. Blank uses the class level.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.casting.levelCapHint: A ladder key whose rung at the character's level is the highest level this tradition can reach (the gnostic invocation level). It is shown on the character sheet and does not change the caster level.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.casting.spellList: Spell list: {count} spell(s) referenced; the picker offers only these.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.templates.none: No templates — add one to offer it at chargen.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.templates.package.bui: Materialize each template as a bundle of world documents — repair an item there once and every character generated from it gets the fix. Rows already bound are left alone.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.templates.package.uni: Nothing names which weapon these are, so a character granted one reads as non-proficient with it: {items}. Open each and set its Weapon type under Construction.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.templates.package.det: Packages detached — this class applies its printed entries again. The documents are left in the world.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.templates.package.unb: Detach the package — the row's own entries apply again
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.templates.package.mis: Bound package no longer exists — detach it or rebuild.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.templates.package.lef: Also granted — the package could not carry these entries, so they apply from the lists below.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.templates.package.dro: No package bound — the entries below apply as printed. Build packages, or drop a bundle item on this row.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.capCiteTip: Read from {cite} when the class was imported, or as set on this sheet.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.capBuiltTip: Derived on the Builder tab from its racial value and the imported builder tables, or set on this sheet.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.factored: Racial modifiers already factored into the tables
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.factoredHint: Demi-human spreads print their tables with racial save adjustments included. When checked, nothing may add those adjustments again.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.title: Title
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.label: Label
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.dropHere: Drop a Proficiency item (an ability) from the Items tab or a compendium onto this list.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.dropAward: Drop a Proficiency item (an ability) anywhere on this list to add a fixed grant at the last level listed, or on a row to set that row's grant.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.dropTemplate: Drop an ability, a weapon, armour, an item or a spell on this template to add it to the list it belongs in. Drop a bundle to bind it as the package.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.refField: Reference. Filled by dropping the document here; a library id or a uuid: may also be typed.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.unresolvedRef: Nothing in the world or the library answers this reference. Drop the document here again, or import it.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.unresolvedName: A printed name with no document behind it. Drop the ability here to resolve it.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.unresolvedHint: Names the import could not match to any ability. Drop the right ability onto the list above and remove the name here.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.keyHint: The id other documents use to find this class and its ladders. Leave it blank and the ladders are published to nothing.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.keyMissing: This class has ladders but no Key, so no ability or tradition can read them. Set a Key in the header.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.ladderKeyHint: A ladder is read by its key. The keys damageBonus, meleeDamageBonus, missileDamageBonus and electedDamageBonus are applied as the damage bonus; any other key is read by abilities, skills and casting traditions that name it.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.confirm.award: Remove this award? The awards after it move up one place. A character that already took a later award is keyed to its old place on the ladder.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.what.templateDrop: an ability, a weapon, armour, an item, a spell or a bundle
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.dropNotAccepted: {name} cannot go here: this list takes {what}.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.training.hint: What a character of this class is trained to fight with. Written onto the class as its training effect and copied to a character when the class is applied; a character already made keeps the training they have.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.training.weaponsHint: Comma-separated grant tokens: a weapon, a category, melee:<size>, missile:all, all
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.awardRow.listedHint: Listed options — drop abilities on this row; the player picks from these:
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.templates.name: Template name
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.templates.baseRefHint: drop a weapon, armour or item here
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.templates.spellUuidHi: The spell document granted. Filled by dropping a spell here; a uuid may be typed. Empty, the printed name is matched against the world's spells at chargen.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.templates.selectionHi: The pick this ability comes with, for an ability that takes one.

ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.inventory.skillsHint: Drop a Proficiency item (an ability) here, then name the ladder on the Progression tab that gives its throw at each level.
ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.noRequirements: None — any character may take this class.

ACKS-CLASSES.apply.noChanges: {name} already matches the class tables — nothing to change.
ACKS-CLASSES.apply.stub: {name} has no progression rows yet; fill or import it before applying.

ACKS-CLASSES.pick.tooltip: Pick a class document and apply its tables
ACKS-CLASSES.assign.packageHint: A starting package is optional here. Leave it off for a character who already has their gear.
ACKS-CLASSES.assign.packageAdds: This package is ADDED to what the character already holds — nothing they own is removed or replaced.

ACKS-CLASSES.assign.ladderNone: This level leaves nothing further to choose.

ACKS-CLASSES.sheet.sortOrderHint: Where this class sits when classes are listed as the books print them — the book's rank times a thousand, plus the page it starts on. Leave it at 0 and it is worked out from the class's own citation.

ACKS-CLASSES.levelup.openHint: A choice left open stays open — this wizard asks only for the level being gained. Answer it later from the class picker: the graduation-cap button beside the class name.
ACKS-CLASSES.levelup.ready: {name} has the experience for level {level} — open the sheet and press the level-up arrow.
ACKS-CLASSES.levelup.noClass: {name} is not bound to a class document.
ACKS-CLASSES.levelup.capped: {name}'s experience stops at {xp}: {lost} XP was not recorded (RR ch. 6, experience from adventuring).
ACKS-CLASSES.levelup.moved: {name} is now level {level}, so this level-up was not applied.
ACKS-CLASSES.levelup.failed.level: {name}'s level-up stopped before the new level was written ({error}). Nothing changed.
ACKS-CLASSES.levelup.failed.grants: {name}'s level-up stopped while granting abilities ({error}). ACKS-CLASSES.levelup.failed.hitPoints: {name}'s level-up stopped while writing hit points ({error}). ACKS-CLASSES.levelup.failed.chat: {name}'s level-up was applied, but its chat summary could not be posted ({error}).

ACKS-CLASSES.zero.chat.title: {name} leaves 0th level as {class}.
ACKS-CLASSES.zero.erodesHint: Marked when this character left 0th level, as over the general limit. The Judge removes these as game time passes (RR ch. 6).
ACKS-CLASSES.chargen.noneQualify: No class in this world accepts these scores. A Judge may offer them anyway.
ACKS-CLASSES.chargen.rollFirst: Roll the template die to see which packages it reaches.
ACKS-CLASSES.chargen.noTemplates: This class has no starting packages in this world, so there is nothing to choose here.
ACKS-CLASSES.chargen.judgeUnlockHint: Offer every class and every template whatever the dice say, ignore the campaign's attribute rule, and set any rolled field by hand. Remembered for you.

ACKS-CLASSES.chargen.goldFromTemplate: The chosen package pays the starting coin
ACKS-CLASSES.chargen.methodHint.standard: The dice the attribute buttons offer follow the printed method (RR ch. 1, Attributes).
ACKS-CLASSES.chargen.methodHint.gritty: The dice the attribute buttons offer follow this variant (JJ ch. 16, Generating Gritty Characters).
ACKS-CLASSES.chargen.methodHint.heroic: The dice the attribute buttons offer follow this variant (JJ ch. 16, Generating Heroic Characters).
ACKS-CLASSES.chargen.methodHint.legendar: The dice the attribute buttons offer follow this variant (JJ ch. 16, Generating Legendary Characters).

ACKS-CLASSES.chargen.nothingApplied: No class and template were chosen, so only the scores were saved.
ACKS-CLASSES.chargen.failed: The class and template could not be applied. See the console for what went wrong.
ACKS-CLASSES.builder.enabledHint: Compose this class from build values instead of typing the printed tables. Deriving writes the standard fields, so applying the class works identically in either mode.
ACKS-CLASSES.builder.deriveHint: Writes level XP, hit die, maximum level, attack throws, saves-as, cleaves, casting grids and racial traits onto this class. Fields the tables cannot answer are left untouched.
ACKS-CLASSES.builder.damageBonusHint: Read only with the trade-off that keeps one side of the damage bonus: melee or missile fixes it for the class; blank leaves the choice to each character at first apply.
ACKS-CLASSES.builder.magicHint: One row per magic value category — arcane, divine, ceremonial, gnostic, alchemy, eldritch, fairie, or any tradition your imported tables define. The type keys a row of the magicTypes table.
ACKS-CLASSES.builder.delayedHint: The Judges Journal's delayed-progress option. Recorded; the derivation flags it for hand adjustment rather than guessing.
ACKS-CLASSES.builder.racialValueHint: -1 for a class with no racial category; 0 or more for a racial class.
ACKS-CLASSES.builder.raceUnresolved: This class names a race no world document carries. Import or create the race, then rebind it here.
ACKS-CLASSES.builder.unknownTradeoffs: Chosen but not in the imported tables
ACKS-CLASSES.builder.xpAdjustmentHint: Added to the 2nd-level XP cost for anything the tables cannot express — a Judge's ruling, a priced power.
ACKS-CLASSES.builder.confirmIntro: Deriving will write the following onto this class document:

ACKS-CLASSES.race.keyHint: The id classes use to bind this race. Leave it blank and a class cannot find it by key.
ACKS-CLASSES.race.powersHint: Powers this rung grants — drop abilities on the rung, or add a row and drop one there.

ACKS-CLASSES.builder.issues.attackFromPa: Attack throws were generated from the progression parameters — verify the bands against the printed table.
ACKS-CLASSES.builder.issues.missingAttac: No attack grid, chassis, or progression parameters answer this fighting value.
ACKS-CLASSES.builder.issues.missingRacia: No racial level-cap row for {points} total build points.
ACKS-CLASSES.builder.issues.missingDamag: The fighting value grants a damage bonus, but no fighter ladder exists to borrow.
ACKS-LIB.settings.look.name: ACKS look
ACKS-LIB.settings.look.hint: Whose palette and lettering everything this module draws uses. World default follows the Judge's choice for the table (Default look and sheets, above). Book style is the ACKS look — burgundy, inscriptional capitals, square corners. System style hands it all back: every ACKS surface, including this module's own windows, draws in the colours and faces your client is already using, and the two settings below stop applying. Per player.
ACKS-LIB.settings.uiPreset.name: Default look and sheets (world)
ACKS-LIB.settings.uiPreset.hint: Whose defaults every seat in this world opens on. Foundry hands the look back to Foundry's own colours and faces; ACKS system keeps the ACKS look and opens the system's own sheets; ACKS Extras keeps the look and opens this module's sheets. Where the chosen set has no sheet for a type, the next set that does is used — Extras, then the system, then Foundry. A player may still pick their own look below, and Foundry's Configure Default Sheets still pins a single type. Asked once at the first launch; a change takes full effect after a reload.
ACKS-LIB.uiPreset.prompt.title: Default look and sheets
ACKS-LIB.uiPreset.prompt.lead: Choose what this world opens on. This is the default for every seat: each player can still pick their own look under Configure Settings, and any single sheet type can still be pinned through Foundry's Configure Default Sheets.
ACKS-LIB.uiPreset.prompt.foundry: No ACKS styling anywhere. Windows draw in Foundry's own colours and faces. Sheets fall back to the next set that has one — Extras, then the system.
ACKS-LIB.uiPreset.prompt.acksCore: The ACKS look, and the system's own sheets where it has one. Types only this module gives a sheet — parties, locations, vehicles, groups — keep this module's.
ACKS-LIB.uiPreset.prompt.acksExtras: The ACKS look and this module's sheets throughout: the character sheet, the item sheet, the full monster block and the follower card.
ACKS-LIB.uiPreset.prompt.note: Change it later under Configure Settings → ACKS II — Extras → Default look and sheets. Close this window to be asked again at the next launch.
ACKS-LIB.uiPreset.prompt.keep: Keep as is, don't ask again
ACKS-LIB.settings.theme.name: ACKS colour scheme
ACKS-LIB.settings.theme.hint: Which palette the ACKS windows draw in. Follow Foundry matches whatever colour scheme the rest of your client uses; Always light and Always dark hold the ACKS look steady regardless. Ignored under System style, where light and dark are Foundry's own. Per player.
ACKS-LIB.settings.sheetStyle.name: ACKS styling on system sheets
ACKS-LIB.settings.sheetStyle.hint: How much of the ACKS look the system's own sheets and dialogs take. Full dress restyles the furniture too — banners, tabs and write-in fields — and widens the character sheet to fit it. Palette only keeps the system's own layout and spacing, and changes nothing but the colours. Both follow your colour scheme. Ignored under System style. Per player.
ACKS-LIB.settings.fontScale.name: ACKS font size
ACKS-LIB.settings.fontScale.hint: Base size (px) for every ACKS surface — follower cards, module apps, and, under Book style, the system sheets. One knob for the whole family; Foundry's own UI scale applies on top. Per player.
ACKS-LIB.library.gmOnly: Only a Judge can rearrange the compendium library.
ACKS-LIB.library.restoreBody: Put {packs} compendium(s) back into the {folders} folder(s) the game system and this module declare — the system's packs into the system's own shelves, this module's and everything you have imported into its own.
ACKS-LIB.library.restoreCost: Any arrangement you made yourself is overwritten: folders you moved packs into, custom ordering, locks and player visibility all go back to their defaults. Nothing inside a compendium is touched and nothing is deleted.
ACKS-LIB.library.restoreDone: Library restored: {packs} compendium(s) filed across {folders} folder(s); {removed} empty folder(s) removed.
ACKS-LIB.managedEffect.refused: {name} is maintained by {owner} and cannot be deleted. Open it and clear its changes if you want it to do nothing, or disable it.
ACKS-LIB.managedEffect.locked: Maintained by the module. Edit or disable it — it cannot be deleted.
ACKS-LIB.settings.advanceWorldTime.name: Advance the world clock
ACKS-LIB.settings.advanceWorldTime.hint: Let this module move Foundry's world time: dungeon turns advance it by a turn's length, and a location's "Advance 1 week" button advances it seven days. Keeps Active Effect durations and calendar modules in step. Turn it off if another module (e.g. Simple Timekeeping) is the only clock authority — everything else still works, this module just stops writing the time.
ACKS-LIB.settings.dawnHour.name: The hour it gets light
ACKS-LIB.settings.dawnHour.hint: On the world clock's own calendar. Blank: a quarter of the way through its day (6 on a 24-hour day). Everything that asks whether it is dark reads this pair.
ACKS-LIB.settings.duskHour.name: The hour it gets dark
ACKS-LIB.settings.duskHour.hint: On the world clock's own calendar. Blank: three quarters of the way through its day (18 on a 24-hour day). A dusk before its dawn runs the light over midnight.
ACKS-LIB.settings.manageVision.name: Token vision from ACKS senses
ACKS-LIB.settings.manageVision.hint: Set each token's sight from its sheet: ordinary eyes see only what is lit, lightless vision and a thief's shadowy senses see their own radius as dim light, and night vision brightens dim light without piercing true dark. Also emits light from a lit torch, lantern or candle the character carries. Edit a token's vision by hand and this leaves that token alone from then on.
ACKS-LIB.delayedDamage.title: Delayed damage
ACKS-LIB.delayedDamage.refused: Delayed damage from {source} was not applied to {name}: {why}.

ACKS-LIB.AURA.FIELDS.sourceUuid.hint: The item whose row this reach runs. Written when the item is raised; a behavior made by hand holds none and does nothing.
ACKS-LIB.AURA.FIELDS.bearerUuid.label: Bearer

ACKS-LIB.AURA.FIELDS.rowKey.label: Row
ACKS-LIB.aura.refused.unsupported: This version of Foundry lacks what a reach is made of, so it was not raised.
ACKS-LIB.aura.refused.gone: The token or the item for this reach could not be found.
ACKS-LIB.aura.refused.notOwner: You do not own the token this reach is raised on.
ACKS-LIB.aura.refused.notCarried: The item is not carried by the token it was raised on.
ACKS-LIB.aura.refused.noRange: The reach has no radius. Nothing is imported for it and none was set.

ACKS-LIB.aura.engaged.scale: An engaged reach is drawn one battle-map square wide (RR p. 288). This scene's grid square is another size, so the ring does not match its squares.
ACKS-LIB.aura.engaged.noToken: {name} holds an engaged reach but has no token on a scene, so no ring was made (RR p. 291).
ACKS-LIB.aura.engaged.denied: Foundry refused the engaged reach's Region for {name}, so no ring was made (RR p. 291).
ACKS-LIB.itemRun.card.earlyTip: Save now, before this body's moment. The Judges are told it was asked early.
ACKS-LIB.itemRun.card.saveTip: Roll this body's save. The result is written to this card and to the whispered one.
ACKS-LIB.itemRun.card.undoTip: Remove the records this save wrote. The body is asked again at its next moment.
ACKS-LIB.itemRun.card.countInTip: Count the bearer as one of its own item's subjects. It is read at the bearer's own turn start, and the item's row keeps the choice.
ACKS-LIB.itemRun.card.countOutTip: Stop counting the bearer as a subject of its own item. Prompts still open for it are struck, what a save wrote stays, and lowering does not change this choice.
ACKS-LIB.itemRun.card.countSubjectTip: The filter could not settle this body, so the item has not reached it. Count it in for this use, and it is treated as reached.
ACKS-LIB.itemRun.card.countSubjectRaised: The filter could not settle this body, so the item has not reached it. Count it in, and it is treated as reached for as long as the item stays raised.
ACKS-LIB.itemRun.card.tip.held: {item} holds {part} on this body while it is inside the reach. It asks no save, and the part comes off when the body leaves.
ACKS-LIB.itemRun.card.bearerTip: The bearer's own row. Core never counts the bearer inside its own reach, so it is not counted until an owner of the item counts it in.
ACKS-LIB.itemRun.card.checkTip: Read who is inside the reach now. Rows are listed or muted to match; nobody is asked.
ACKS-LIB.itemRun.card.lowerTip: Lower the reach. Its conditions end; a pass's window stays.
ACKS-LIB.itemRun.card.tip.distance: {feet}′ from {name}, measured now between the nearest edges of the two tokens on the scene grid. The reach's ring decides who is inside.
ACKS-LIB.itemRun.card.life.mark: until it first starts a turn in a fight
ACKS-LIB.itemRun.card.earlyWarn: {item}: {name} was asked for its save before its moment, on a Judge's press.
ACKS-LIB.itemRun.card.life.timed: until its timed interval runs out
ACKS-LIB.itemRun.card.engagedNoteTip: The adjacent square of the battle map (RR p. 288, p. 291).

ACKS-LIB.statusPalette.title: Token Status Palette

ACKS-LIB.repair.title: Repair This World

ACKS-LIB.repair.check.attachments.label: Carried by an actor that is gone

ACKS-LIB.repair.check.strandedCoin.label: Coin inside actors that cannot load
ACKS-LIB.repair.check.strandedCoin.hint: An actor whose type belongs to a module that is not installed or not enabled cannot be opened, so the coin inside it is out of reach. Listed so you can see what it holds.
ACKS-LIB.repair.check.strandedCoin.repor: Listed only: this version does not move the coin.
ACKS-LIB.repair.check.twoHandedRow.label: Weapons whose alternate damage differs from their imported row
ACKS-LIB.repair.check.twoHandedRow.hint: Weapons imported from your weapon table whose stored alternate damage is not the one the table row names: the row's die where it names one, blank where it names none. A weapon created without one can store the system's default die there, which the sheet and the roll then offer as a second grip. Fixing writes the row's value into the alternate damage field. A weapon with no imported row is never listed.
ACKS-LIB.repair.check.missingImages.hint: Actors, their prototype tokens, items, effects, macros, roll tables and scene tokens whose image is a file on this server that no longer exists, so the browser logs a not-found error every time it is shown. Scanning asks the server once for each distinct file, and skips remote addresses and embedded images. Fixing puts the kind's default image there, or for token art the actor's image when that file is present. A scene's thumbnail and level images, a journal page's file and a roll-table result's image are listed only, since none has a default image.
ACKS-LIB.repair.check.missingImages.noDe: No default image exists for this field: choose another file for it by hand.
ACKS-LIB.repair.check.legacyEffectKeys.l: Effects keyed to the system's old field names

The system's own migration does not rewrite effect keys, so such a change reaches nothing. Fixing rewrites each key to the current name; a key with no current counterpart is listed only.

ACKS-ABILITIES.mech.repeatable: May Be Selected More Than Once
ACKS-ABILITIES.mech.qtyHint: How many times this character has taken it — one entry carrying a count, not repeated copies. What the count means depends on the ability: another rank of the same thing, or another pick from its list.
ACKS-ABILITIES.mech.qtyConflict: Taken more than once, but this ability is not marked as repeatable — one of the two is wrong.
ACKS-ABILITIES.mech.powerValueHint: How many custom powers this counts as when building a class. Blank for proficiencies.
ACKS-ABILITIES.mech.languageGrantTip: How many languages this ability grants. Blank grants none.
ACKS-ABILITIES.mech.languageGrantCiteTip: How many languages this ability grants. Blank grants none. Page: {cite}
ACKS-ABILITIES.mech.providesHint: What this ability lets you do, named independently of this entry. A prerequisite written against a capability is met by any ability providing it — and holding the same capability twice does not stack.
ACKS-ABILITIES.mech.effectsHint: What this ability does, as read from your book. Each modifier row is marked with what the sheet does with it. An Active Effect of your own under Effects below that writes the same field stands in for the row, so the two never add twice.
ACKS-ABILITIES.mech.noEffects: No structured effects. The full text streams from your own book when connected.
ACKS-ABILITIES.mech.addRowHint: A row you add or change here is yours until the ability is repaired from your book, which reads every row again.
ACKS-ABILITIES.mech.disposition.standing: Written to the character's sheet while the ability is held. The Stats tab's tooltip names it.
ACKS-ABILITIES.mech.disposition.gatedTip: Written to the sheet only while the character meets the row's gate, checked against the current loadout.
ACKS-ABILITIES.mech.disposition.atRollTi: Narrower than any sheet field (one kind of opponent, one activity), so it is left to the roll it applies to.
ACKS-ABILITIES.mech.disposition.situatio: Applies only in circumstances the sheet does not track. Not applied; the Judge decides when it counts.
ACKS-ABILITIES.mech.disposition.consumed: Read by the feature that owns this figure (reactions, proficiency throws, hirelings, markets), not written to the sheet.
ACKS-ABILITIES.mech.disposition.unsuppor: The sheet has no field this row can write, or the row sets or caps a figure rather than adding to it.
ACKS-ABILITIES.mech.unverifiedTip: Read by the generic scan, not by a recipe checked against the page. It applies, so check it against your book.
ACKS-ABILITIES.mech.appliesToRollTip: This row belongs to the {roll} throw on the Rolls tab, and to no other throw.
ACKS-ABILITIES.quick.startTip: Add this row as an Active Effect on this character's copy. While it is on, it takes the row's place, so the figure counts once.
ACKS-ABILITIES.quick.startOffTip: Add this row as an Active Effect on this character's copy, turned off. Turn it on under Effects while the circumstance holds.
ACKS-ABILITIES.quick.refreshTip: Rewrite the effect at the row's figure for the character's current level and rank. Whether it is on is kept.
ACKS-ABILITIES.quick.onTip: This row's Active Effect is on and writes the figure; the row itself stands aside.
ACKS-ABILITIES.quick.offTip: This row's Active Effect is off. Turn it on under Effects while the circumstance holds.
ACKS-ABILITIES.quick.staleTip: The level, the rank or the row changed since this row's Active Effect was made, so its figure may be out of date. Refresh rewrites it.

ACKS-ABILITIES.roll.field.label: Name
ACKS-ABILITIES.roll.field.labelHint: What the book calls this particular throw. An ability with several throws is read by these names.
ACKS-ABILITIES.roll.field.scoreNone: None — the throw takes no score
ACKS-ABILITIES.roll.field.scoreTimes: How many times the modifier counts
ACKS-ABILITIES.roll.field.scoreHint: An ability score the character adds to this throw. The box beside it is how many times the modifier counts — leave it at 1 for a plain one. It is folded into the target shown everywhere, so a throw reads differently for two characters.
ACKS-ABILITIES.roll.scoreUnapplied: {term} — not added to this throw's target (roll type: exact match).
ACKS-ABILITIES.roll.scoreInResult: {term} — added to the result, since the throw has no target to move.
ACKS-ABILITIES.roll.field.rollTypeHint: Whether the result must reach the target, stay under it, or match it exactly — or “no target”, for a throw that is not scored against anything and whose result is the answer itself.
ACKS-ABILITIES.roll.field.conditionPlace: e.g. only on a domesticated animal
ACKS-ABILITIES.roll.field.conditionHint: Leave blank when the throw is always available. It shows under the roll and on the chat card.
ACKS-ABILITIES.roll.field.kindHint: Flat never changes. Per Level moves by a fixed step. Breakpoints is a level table you type out. Progression follows a class table.
ACKS-ABILITIES.roll.field.scaleHint: What the target is read against. Class Level for most; Rank for the proficiencies rated by how many times they were taken.
ACKS-ABILITIES.roll.field.flatHint: The same number at every level. Leave blank for a throw whose target the book does not give.
ACKS-ABILITIES.roll.field.baseHint: The target at the bottom of the scale — 1st level, or one rank.
ACKS-ABILITIES.roll.field.perHint: How much it moves each step after that. A target that gets easier moves down, so write it negative.
ACKS-ABILITIES.roll.field.asHint: For a throw rated off another class’s table. Pick the class and which of its tables, then the fraction of your own level to read it at — leave the boxes blank for the whole level.
ACKS-ABILITIES.roll.field.roundHint: Only for a target that lands on a fraction. The book always prints the rounding beside it.
ACKS-ABILITIES.roll.table.empty: No steps yet. Add one for each point where the printed table changes.
ACKS-ABILITIES.roll.table.hint: A step holds from where it starts until the next one begins, so only the points where the number changes need typing.
ACKS-ABILITIES.mech.selectionsHint: What each take chose, comma-separated and order-aligned with Times Taken - the weapon group, style, discipline, or other pick this ability spends its takes on. Leave blank for abilities where a repeat deepens a rank instead of widening a list.
ACKS-ABILITIES.mech.selectionsWeaponHint: A size box covers every melee weapon of that size and the missile box every missile weapon. A single weapon is typed by name in the line and stays as typed: a box is a whole group, so "sword" is the one weapon and "swords" ticks the group.

enforceMode.name: Equip-limit enforcement
enforceMode.hint: How to handle RAW-illegal equip attempts (too many hands, a second armour suit, a shield with no free hand).

proficiencyEnforcement.name: Proficiency penalties
proficiencyEnforcement.hint: Whether weapon, armour, and fighting-style proficiency PENALTIES are enforced (Non-Proficient Use). Positive facts from ACKS Abilities characters — Weapon Finesse, a Specialization's style, Martial/Armour Training picks, Weapon Focus — always apply through the bridge regardless of this setting. Always enforce reads each character's training from its class (character sheet → Stats tab → Training block) and from its imported proficiency abilities. Automatic keeps penalties off while this module's ACKS Abilities feature is loaded, and that feature is always loaded, so Automatic acts as Never enforce.
proficiencyEnforcement.auto: Automatic — acts as Never enforce, since the ACKS Abilities feature is always loaded; bridged bonuses still apply
proficiencyEnforcement.on: Always enforce — training comes from the class (character sheet → Stats tab → Training block) and imported proficiency abilities (default)
proficiencyEnforcement.off: Never enforce (equip limits, styles, and bridged bonuses still apply)

rollAutomation.name: Automate attack/damage rolls
rollAutomation.hint: Inject RAW fighting-style and proficiency modifiers into attack and damage rolls (Weapon Finesse, dual-wield, two-handed damage, Weapon Focus, Precise Shooting, non-proficiency). Requires libWrapper. Turn off to apply only always-on bonuses via the loadout effect.

overlayShieldVariants.hint: Buckler, auxiliary, crescent, heater, kite, and phalanx shields with strap positions and vulnerable rules.

overlayManeuvers.name: Overlay: combat maneuvers
overlayManeuvers.hint: Special-maneuver helpers (disarm, knock down, wrestle, sunder, etc.) aware of Combat Trickery and weapon qualities.

overlayItemLoss.name: Overlay: item loss from damage (JJ)
overlayItemLoss.hint: Destroy carried equipment on heavy area damage.

overlayMounted.name: Overlay: mounted saves
overlayMounted.hint: Tracks the saves a rider owes to stay mounted (RR p. 308).

overlayNamed.name: Overlay: named magic items (JJ)
overlayNamed.hint: Named arms and armour that unlock bonuses by level.

overlayEnclosingHelm.name: Overlay: enclosing helmet
overlayEnclosingHelm.hint: Applies an enclosing helmet's modifiers to its wearer (RR p. 140).

ammoTracking.name: Track ammunition & thrown weapons
ammoTracking.hint: On a missile attack, decrement the matching ammunition (arrows/bolts/stones) or the thrown weapon by one. A single thrown weapon (hand axe, javelin) is marked as thrown — unequipped and weightless until recovered — rather than destroyed. Recovery is manual (Recover Thrown Weapons macro); RAW specifies no automatic recovery. Requires libWrapper.
