Ticked entries are repaired in place; everything else is left alone, and so is an entry whose book is not open on this seat. Rules tables are read into the world rather than filed on a shelf, so ticking one re-reads it in place. A tool for checking one entry at a time — the shelf and book repairs are the everyday controls.

ACKS-IMPORTER.manager.importIntro: The import chain, in the order that lands prerequisites first. Run it whole, or one step when its documents are missing or were deleted; every step passes over what the world already holds. Repair everything writes a fresh read, in place, over everything imported from every book open on this seat, after one confirm.

Repair writes a fresh read, in place, over what was imported from the book, imports what is missing, refreshes its maps and writes the Adventure anew; an edit you made to what the import wrote is listed for you to keep or to take the book's value. Write Adventure writes the Adventure alone.

ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.key: The name a repair matches this row by. It is set when the row is made and is not edited here.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.saveEffect: What a passed saving throw does to this row's effect. Blank takes the spell's own.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.delivery: The attack throw the caster must land before this row applies. None needs no throw.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.extraordinary: Whether the damage carries the extraordinary mark. Unset means nothing was read for it.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.lasts: Whether this row is applied once at the cast or runs for the spell's duration.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.recur: Whether this row repeats while the spell lasts.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.pick: A name shared by the rows the caster chooses between; one row of the group is taken.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.reversed: Marks a row of the spell's reversed form.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.notStacksWith: Keywords of the sources this row's figure does not add to, separated by commas.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.stacksWith: Keywords of the sources this row's figure adds to, separated by commas.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.max: The most instances of this row a cast makes. The count it caps is the row's value; blank is no ceiling.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.pickOption: Rows of one choice group that share this name are one option the caster takes together. Blank makes the row an option of its own.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.invocationFrom: The lowest invocation level this row applies at, counted in. Blank is open below.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.invocationTo: The highest invocation level this row applies at, counted in. Blank is open above.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.recurAt: Whose turn a repeating row resolves on: the caster's, or the start or the end of its bearer's.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.recurSave: A saving throw the bearer makes before each repeat. A pass ends this row, or the whole cast; a fail writes a condition row's conditions, and on a row that recurs from the later rounds nothing else is written at the cast. Blank asks none.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.recurTarget: Who a repeat meets. Blank is the bearer; the other choice is a target the caster picks each time.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.rounds: A dice formula for the bearer's rounds, used when this row lasts a number of rounds. Blank leaves the row untimed.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.exemptSizeFrom: A creature size key. A target of that size or larger is exempt from this row only. Blank exempts none.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.ownSave: Applies to the saving throw made against this spell itself, tested for each saver at that throw. Pair it with a Target of save.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.pickKind: The caster picks one of the kinds listed under Only versus kinds when casting, and the row applies against that kind. Until a pick is offered, the first kind stands.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.attackKinds: The kinds of attack made against the bearer that this row answers. None checked is every kind.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.endsOn: What ends the record this row writes: the bearer losing hit points, or making an attack throw of its own.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.untimed: Conditions this row writes with no clock of their own, taken from the conditions the row lists.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.exemptSizeOver: A creature size key. A target larger than that size is exempt from this row only. Blank exempts none.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.ifHas: Reference keys, separated by commas. The row counts only while the character also holds all of them.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.appliesToRoll: The key of the throw this row modifies. Blank is not scoped to a single throw.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.schools: Words naming the schools of spell this row concerns, separated by commas. A spell with any one of them matches.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.elements: Words naming the elements of spell this row concerns, separated by commas. A spell with any one of them matches.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.bySelection: Narrows the row to spells that name one of the elements or schools picked on the ability.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.saveCategories: The categories of saving throw a save row concerns, separated by commas.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.perDie: The figure is added once per die of the damage formula, not once for the roll.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.gate.occasion: The status gate holds only on a roll that names that status as its occasion. On any other roll it stays undecided.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.lightBand: In feet, from the light. Blank sheds nothing at that level.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.controlEnd: What becomes of the creatures when the caster's control of them ends: they stay, they go, or they turn hostile. Blank reads as they stay (RR ch. 5, Summoning Spells).
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.lastsTracked: How long this row's record stands: for the spell's duration, or only at the cast.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.tip.effectsDelay: The effects this row holds back on its recipient while the row lasts.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.statusTip: The row counts only while the character carries this status. Blank counts it everywhere.
ACKS-LIB.effectEditor.statusLocked: This row already carries another kind of gate, which a status would replace. Clear that gate first.

ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.screen.count.f: Lots found so far, from the pot. Open the pot to see them.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.screen.count.u: Entries on the board that no check, hasty or methodical, has been made at.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.screen.press.t: What a Round and a Turn would resolve, from the checks assigned now.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.screen.press.r: Round: 1 hasty check resolves at once.
Round: {n} hasty checks resolve at once.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.screen.turn.ti: Turns the party has spent, from its clock.
Resolve the hasty checks assigned: a round each, at once.
Spend a turn: the party's turn plan resolves, as the Dungeon tab's Advance turn does.
Ask the Judge for a Round. The Judge's own press resolves it.
Ask the Judge to spend a turn. The Judge's own press spends it.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.screen.row.tip: A hasty check takes a round and resolves at once on the Round press.
Turns this check takes on the turn plan: {n}. It resolves when the last is spent.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.screen.sheet.g: This body's sheet is gone, so there is none to open.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.screen.chip.st: {name} cannot check this hastily again (RR ch. 6, Searching)
Drag onto an entry to assign this character to its check.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.screen.finds.t: What the checks at this entry found. Lots found go to the pot.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.screen.tell.va: There might be something more here.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.screen.judge.l: Lots waiting, found by a check made {how}: {n}.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.screen.judge.s: Nothing shows it: the Judge shows it.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.screen.judge.t: Judge only: the lots dealt for this entry wait under the check named, and are marked found when it succeeds.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.screen.log.emp: Assign the party, then spend a turn.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.screen.log.thr: The throw and its target, read from the Judges' card.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.screen.foot.ju: Judge's log: throws are secret and shown here only. The table's log says who searched what, and never whether something was missed.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.screen.foot.pl: You assign your own characters; the Judge assigns anyone. Whether something more remains is shown openly, unless it hides behind a clue you have not solved.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.screen.tray.no: No pot was dealt for this search.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.screen.tray.he: Dealt by the Judge's roll when the scene opened. Solid: found, and visible to the table as found. Dashed: not yet found (Judge only).
What the party has found. Open the pot for its window.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.keying.title: Keying: {name}
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.keying.refusal: That thing is no longer at this place.
That is not a check this entry can make.
Turns are a whole number of one or more.
That clue is not a thing of this place.
That clue is already behind this entry.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.keying.derived: A door read off the map's walls. It is not keyed here.
An old-style trap zone read off the map. It is not keyed here.
A body from the fight's record. It is not keyed here.
Players do not see this entry until it is shown.
The clue whose check, once found, shows this entry. Only a hidden entry can be behind one.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.keying.more.ti: The line the table reads when something more remains here. Left blank, the table reads the generic words.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.keying.check.t: What this check rolls, if anything.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.keying.skill.t: The proficiency whose throw this check makes.
Lets a member without the searching capability make this check as well. (RR ch. 6, Searching)
The clue the table reads when this check is found.
1 lot is dealt here (set when the scene opens).
{n} lots are dealt here (set when the scene opens).
Shows 1 entry (set on that entry's Behind).
Shows {n} entries (set on each entry's Behind).
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.keying.tools.t: Items a member must carry to make this check. Drop an item from the sidebar, a compendium or a sheet.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.keying.turns.t: Turns this check takes. (RR ch. 6, Searching)
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.keying.crossin: {field}: what a crossing begun from this place starts with. Left blank, the crossing panel’s own stands.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.keying.show.ti: Shows this entry to the players now. A Reset of the place hides it again.
Takes this thing off the place. The document it points at is not touched.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.keying.add: Add to this place: drop a trap, an obstacle or a condition on the map or on the place's sheet. Doors and old trap zones come from the map and are not keyed here.
Open an entry to key it.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.keying.tab.dro: Drop a trap, an obstacle or a condition here, or on the place's area on the map. Goods dropped here still go to the place's goods.
A trap, obstacle or condition item becomes a thing of this place; any other item is stored as goods.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.keying.tab.emp: Nothing is keyed at this place yet.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.keying.tab.ope: Open this thing to key its layers.
ACKS-LOCATION.sceneSearch.keying.flag.fr: a clue in front of a secret
ACKS-LIB.org.card.handTip: {n} bodies: set by hand. The Roll threw {rolled}. {cites}
ACKS-LIB.org.edit.troopTip: The troop type of these bodies. A type the variant has no band for is marked and can still be chosen.
ACKS-LIB.org.edit.bodiesTip: How many bodies the card holds. A number typed here is kept as set by hand.
ACKS-LIB.org.edit.doneTip: Write the card as it stands. Bodies already on a map keep the figures they went out with until recalled.
ACKS-LIB.org.edit.removeTip: Take this row off this chart. The rows beneath it move up to this row's parent; nothing is deleted.
ACKS-LIB.org.edit.deleteTip: Delete this row, the rows beneath it, their groups and, unless you untick it, their linked actors. Asks first unless the warning was turned off.
ACKS-LIB.org.delete.title: Delete {name}?
ACKS-LIB.org.delete.lead: This deletes {top}, the rows beneath it and their groups.
ACKS-LIB.org.delete.rowsTip: Rows beneath this one, counted from the chart now.
ACKS-LIB.org.delete.prototypesLead: Actors this chart's Rolls minted for its stacks that no other group uses are deleted with them:
ACKS-LIB.org.delete.prototypesTip: Prototypes a Roll of this chart made, named by no group that stays.
ACKS-LIB.org.delete.stays: {name} stays: you cannot delete this actor.
ACKS-LIB.org.delete.dontWarn: Don't warn me before a Delete again
ACKS-LIB.org.delete.dontWarnTip: Saves one-click Delete for this client, with the linked-actor choice above (setting: Warn before deleting chart rows). A one-click Delete applies that choice without asking and offers Undo. Turn the warning back on in Settings tab → Game Settings → ACKS II — Extras.
ACKS-LIB.org.delete.cancelTip: Close. Nothing is deleted and the setting is not changed.
ACKS-LIB.org.undo.rowsTip: Rows the Delete took beneath the row pressed.
ACKS-LIB.org.undo.pressTip: Bring back the rows, their groups, the minted actors and the linked actors this Delete took, with the same ids. Gone when the page is reloaded.
ACKS-LIB.org.undo.dismissTip: Hide this strip. The delete stays.
ACKS-LIB.org.refused.undoFailed: Undo stopped before the chart was written: a document could not be re-created, so the chart was left as it is.
ACKS-LIB.org.remove.title: Remove {name} from this chart?
ACKS-LIB.org.remove.askTop: {name} leaves this chart. The {n} rows under it stay on the chart and move up to the top: {names}. No actor is deleted.
ACKS-LIB.org.remove.askUnder: {name} leaves this chart. The {n} rows under it stay on the chart and move up under {under}: {names}. No actor is deleted.
ACKS-LIB.org.remove.countTip: Rows directly beneath this one, counted from the chart now.
ACKS-LIB.org.unlisted.under: {removed} was taken off the chart; no actor was deleted. These rows moved up under {under}:
ACKS-LIB.org.edit.noTroop: That troop type could not be made, so the bodies keep the one they had.
ACKS-LIB.org.unlisted.title: {removed} was taken off the chart; no actor was deleted. These rows moved up to the top:
ACKS-LIB.org.unlisted.tip: Remove takes one row. The rows beneath it stay on the chart under the removed row's parent, and every group, creature and leader is still in the Actors tab.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.tip.hand: {label}: set by a hand. The import read {read}. {cite}
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.tip.handOnly: {label}: added or changed by a hand.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.problem.chance: A chance is a percentage, or blank for always.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.problem.count: A count is a number, dice, or a share of another part.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.problem.link: A linked creature is an Actor entry.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.problem.fixedHp: A whole number of hit points, or blank to roll.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.title: Recipe · {name}
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.unitsHint: what each side of the encounter counts
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.addHint: Special troops, traits and optional equipment are the family's tables, not parts.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.head.line: Read from the import {cite} · {hand} of {all} parts changed by hand
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.head.tip: Parts changed by hand, counted against every part of the recipe whatever the state. {cite}
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.tip.figure: Read from the recipe row the import wrote. {cite}
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.field.label: Label
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.hint.label: The name the chart shows for this part.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.hint.role: What this part is in the unit. Mount and Beast link a creature imported from its own entry.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.hint.morale: Added to the unit's while this part is alive.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.hint.cite: Where the part was read from.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.hint.fixedHp: Blank: the bodies roll their hit points.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.hint.units: The units the part is counted for. A part with none ticked is counted for no unit.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.leaderNote: The grade is the template's Leader figures axis, chosen at the Roll. A part carries none.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.link.noneTip: No library entry is exactly the word the page prints. Import the creature's own entry, or link one below.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.link.linkedNote: The creature's figures come from its entry; edit them there.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.link.unlinkedNote: Until a link is made, a Roll makes a labelled stack and lists a finding.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.resetPart: Reset this part to the import
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.pane.title: What the importer read
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.pane.unread: Read by no part. Press it to start a part from it.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.partsCountTip: Counted now from the recipe's parts for the tab shown. {cite}
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.pane.unreadTip: Counted now over this entry's imported text.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.pane.unreadPress: Press one to start a part from it.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.foot.saved: Saved. Groups already rolled keep the recipe they were rolled with.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.foot.fix: Fix the marked fields before this part is saved.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.foot.readOnly: Read only: this document is not yours to change.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.notice.noDoc: The recipe editor needs a monster, a family template with a variant option, or a chart's host.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.notice.noOption: {name} has no variant option to edit.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.notice.noRecord: {name} has no Roll recorded, so no variant's recipe is named.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.notice.noWrite: {name} is not yours to change; nothing was written.
ACKS-MONSTERS.recipe.notice.noPart: That part is no longer in the recipe.
ACKS-LIB.org.role.label: {word}: {name}
ACKS-LIB.org.role.fileTip: Read from the chart: this card holds bodies and has no leader.
ACKS-LIB.org.role.championTip: Read from the chart: this leader's unit holds bodies only.
ACKS-LIB.org.role.subTip: Read from the chart: this leader's unit holds units, and the card is below the top of the chart.
ACKS-LIB.org.role.chiefTip: Read from the chart: this leader's unit holds units, and the card is the top of the chart.
ACKS-LIB.org.role.officerTip: This row's officer, set by its + Officer button or by an actor dropped on its officer line; the row names no role.
ACKS-LIB.org.officer.deletedTip: This card's {word} was deleted outside the chart. The card keeps the link until it is cleared or a new one is made.
ACKS-LIB.org.officer.leaderGoneTip: The faction's leader was deleted outside the chart. The faction keeps the link until it is cleared.
ACKS-LIB.org.officer.clearTip: The card no longer has this {word}. The actor stays in the world; where it was the faction's leader, the faction is left with none.
ACKS-LIB.org.officer.clearDeletedTip: Clear the link to the deleted {word}. Where it was the faction's leader, the faction is left with none.
ACKS-LIB.org.officer.makeTip: Make a new {word} actor in the world from this chart's family template and set it as the card's officer. It makes the leader only: no gear or mount is rolled. On a faction's top row it also becomes the faction's leader while that field is blank. Or drop an actor on this line.
ACKS-LIB.org.officer.addTip: Make one actor from this row's own creature, named by the row, and set it as the row's officer. Or drop an actor on this line.
ACKS-LIB.org.officer.addBlankTip: Make one blank actor, named by the row, and set it as the row's officer. Or drop an actor on this line.
ACKS-LIB.org.officer.nameTip: This row's officer. Or drop an actor on this line.
ACKS-LIB.org.officer.dropHint: Drop to make {name} this row's officer
ACKS-LIB.org.refused.officerNotMade: The officer actor could not be made, so nothing was made.
ACKS-LIB.org.officer.makeHostTip: Make a new {word} actor in the world from the family template this faction was rolled from and set it as the faction's leader. It stands beside a leader deleted from the world and in a blank leader line. It makes the leader only: no gear or mount is rolled.
ACKS-LIB.org.officer.deleteTip: Delete the {word}'s actor from the world and clear it from the card. Asks first.
ACKS-LIB.org.officer.deleteAsk: This deletes the actor {name} from the world and clears it from {card}. Other cards that name it are left with a deleted link.
ACKS-LIB.org.refused.noCreate: You may not create actors, so nothing was made.
ACKS-LIB.org.refused.noDelete: You may not delete {name}, so nothing was deleted.
ACKS-LIB.org.refused.noLeader: This card records no leader to make, so nothing was made.
ACKS-LIB.org.refused.leaderNotMade: The leader could not be made from this chart's template, so nothing was made.
ACKS-LIB.org.refused.leaderUnlinked: {name} was made but could not be set as the card's officer. It stays in the world.
ACKS-LIB.org.chart.designTip: Pick each empty unit's share and troop type yourself, then roll what is left blank. Nothing you pick is rolled over.
ACKS-LIB.org.design.title: Design by selection
ACKS-LIB.org.design.unsure: Not offered: the state picked names no one unit for this level. Pick Wandering or Lair.
ACKS-LIB.org.design.shareTip: Which of the line's shares this unit takes. Left on Rolled, the Roll picks it.
ACKS-LIB.org.design.troopTip: The troop type of this unit. A type the variant has no band for is marked and can still be chosen.
ACKS-LIB.org.design.dieTip: Write this unit's picks and roll this row with all below it. The other units stay as they are.
ACKS-LIB.org.edit.dieTip: Roll {name}'s count again from {formula}, as its roll entry gave it. The bodies at rest change; any already on a map stay as they are. {cites}
ACKS-LIB.org.edit.dieFloored: {name} still records {bodies} bodies, more than the dice gave, so its count stays at the bodies it records.
ACKS-LIB.org.refused.noDie: That stack records no dice to roll, so nothing changed.
ACKS-LIB.org.refused.dieFailed: The recorded dice could not be rolled, so nothing changed.
ACKS-MONSTERS.organisation.choice.unprin: Rounding where the page prints none
Used wherever a share or a percentage of bodies comes out in fractions and the line prints no rounding.
ACKS-MONSTERS.organisation.choice.loneSp: A unit alone in its level, divided by shares
How a single unit takes a share where the line splits its level.
ACKS-MONSTERS.organisation.choice.remain: Units the roundings leave without a share
Where the shares' roundings leave units over.
To the share with the largest fraction
ACKS-MONSTERS.organisation.choice.branch: The line lists alternatives of one group; one is present.
ACKS-MONSTERS.organisation.willMake.rowT: {label}: read from the family's imported line, not rolled here. {cite}
ACKS-MONSTERS.organisation.willMake.line: The line as the importer read it for {where}.
